This DOCX demonstrates citations displayed exactly as Quarto/Pandoc markup. Blue monospaced snippets are managed Word content controls, not ordinary pasted text.

# Example citations

Narrative citation: @smith2020 describes an illustrative workflow.

Parenthetical citation: an illustrative statement [@smith2020].

Grouped citation: this example draws on two sample records [@smith2020; @jones2022].

With a page locator: [@jones2022, p. 45].

Suppress author: Jones is mentioned separately, then [-@jones2022] can be used to show only the year after processing.

# Document structure

Normal paragraphs, headings and tables are converted using Pandoc; citation content controls are restored as native Pandoc Cite nodes.

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  Word feature                        Quarto result
  ----------------------------------- -----------------------------------
  Heading 1                           \# Heading

  Managed citation                    Native Pandoc citation

  Table                               Markdown table
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
